title: How to Make the Most of the 2026 TABA Parade of Homes | Temple, Belton & Bell County TX
description:
🏡 TABA Parade of Homes 2026 | New Construction in Temple, Belton & Bell County Texas | Your FREE Guide
Thinking about buying a new construction home in Temple, Belton, Salado, Troy, or anywhere in Bell County, Texas? The 2026 TABA Parade of Homes is your FREE, no-pressure opportunity to walk through brand-new homes with zero appointments required — and we're your local guides to making the most of it.
In this video, we break down everything you need to know: what TABA is, how the Parade works, what's trending in new construction right now, why you NEED a buyer's agent before stepping foot in a model home, and exactly what questions to ask every builder you visit.

📅 2026 TABA PARADE OF HOMES — DATES & TIMES
🗓️ Weekend 1: April 17–19, 2026
🗓️ Weekend 2: April 24–26, 2026
🕕 Fridays: 6pm – 8pm
🕛 Saturdays & Sundays: 12pm – 5pm
Admission is FREE. No appointment needed. Just show up and explore!
👉 Full home map & builder list: tahb.org

We promised it in the video and here it is! We put together the ultimate Parade of Homes Playbook so you can tackle all 27 homes like a pro. Here's what's inside:

This playbook is your cheat code to getting the most out of the 2026 TABA Parade of Homes without the stress of figuring it all out on your own.

🏠 COME SEE US THIS WEEKEND — DB FULLER HOMES
We'll be at a DB Fuller Homes Parade property THIS weekend (and next)  — and this one is worth the stop! Here's what makes these homes stand out:
✨ Upgraded Finishes Throughout — Style is NOT Sacrificed Here:
🔲 Waterfall countertops
🚪 Soft-close cabinets
🎨 Semi-gloss paint throughout (no flat paint!)
🏠 Shingle composition roof
🌿 Upgraded fencing with a spacious backyard

Come find us there this weekend, say hi, and let's talk about what homeownership in Central Texas can look like for YOU. Drop your biggest new construction question in the comments👇
